home.about_h2: Family city guides across Europe: from parking to dinner
home.about_p1: Quolino offers ready-made day-trip plans for families with kids travelling by car across Europe. Every city is laid out hour by hour: where to park, what to see, how much tickets cost, and where to have dinner.
home.about_p2: But Quolino is not just another guide with a list of sights. It's a field game in a real city: every stop has a mission for kids. Find the griffin on the façade, count the stars on the mosaic, photograph the bricked-up window. The child doesn't whine "when are we leaving" because they're busy with the quest. Parents explore in peace.
home.about_p3: Hours adapted to the climate. In warm countries the route avoids midday heat. Sightseeing starts in the late afternoon and ends with dinner at sunset. No battles with 35-degree heat and a sizzling child.
home.about_p4: You start from the parking. Every city opens with info on where to leave the car: with the price, a navigation link, and a ZTL zone warning. No more circling restricted areas and camera fines.
home.about_p5: Currently available region: Marche and Umbria (Italy). 7 cities, 46 stops, complete plans for 7 days. Coming soon: Tuscany, Kraków and surroundings.
home.all_free_text: Open a region on your phone, pick today's city, and go. Nothing to download or sign up for.
